rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server provides complete integration with MobSF (Mobile Security Framework) for automated mobile application security analysis, supporting APK, IPA, and APPX file uploads, comprehensive security scanning, and detailed vulnerability reporting. Built by nkcc-apk using TypeScript and the MobSF REST API, it offers 18 core tools plus 44 specialized section-specific tools for accessing granular report data including permissions analysis, code analysis, certificate validation, network security assessment, and malware detection. The implementation supports the full MobSF workflow from file upload through scan management, report generation (JSON and PDF formats), finding suppression, and comparative analysis between applications, making it valuable for mobile app security testing, DevSecOps pipelines, penetration testing, and compliance validation in enterprise mobile development environments.
